Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Whenever religious principles decline and unrighteousness rises, the Supreme manifests to restore order and balance.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Addressing moral decay, systemic imbalance, and the decline of ethical living in the world.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'yada yada hi dharmasya glanir bhavati bharata... tadatmanam srjamy aham' (Whenever dharma declines and adharma rises, I manifest Myself).
Outcome/Resolution: Provides assurance that cosmic and moral order will always be restored during times of breakdown.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Restoration of Moral Order: Rebuilding alignment with ethical principles after disruption
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Hope During Crisis: Maintaining optimism during periods of moral or personal chaos
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Correction of Imbalance: Re-establishing stability when negative forces dominate

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Yada yada hi dharmasya glanir bhavati (Whenever there is a decline in dharma)
Tadatmanam srjamy aham (Then I manifest Myself)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The Lord descends whenever moral order (dharma) breaks down and unrighteousness prevails, intervening to restore cosmic harmony.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Times of personal or societal crisis are temporary disruptions; trusting that balance can be restored brings peace and prevents despair.
